what_happened: The .olean tree was fresh (no FormalSystem source newer than FormalSystem.olean; no guard holder), so the Section 0 compile record could be produced by a single foreground lake env lean on a scratch file importing FormalSystem instead of a detached lake build.

The RaySummary README states the run-layer phase-2 first lemma as stabilization 'in the deadline counter c', but a ladder state carries two counters (q, c, n) and Count hands a starting region the length n, so realized cells at idle states depend on n as well; the first statement had to be re-derived over the pair (c, n) from Count's definition. Recorded as a sharpening, not a contradiction.
